title: Carasent ASA acquires Data-Al and enters the German market – invitation to webcast 29 October 11:00 CET
content:
Carasent ASA completed an acquisition of Data-Al GmbH, a German electronic health record provider serving private healthcare clinics. The transaction valued Data-Al at an enterprise value of EUR 8 million, with potential earnout payments reaching EUR 4 million based on future performance metrics.

Company Background:
Data-Al, established in Germany in 1988, operates EHR solutions under the Data-Al and Data-Cur brands. The organization maintains 30 employees and serves over 1,000 customers across Germany, primarily small-to-medium sized private clinics.

Financial Context:
Data-Al's 2023 performance showed approximately EUR 4.0 million in revenues and EUR 0.5 million EBITDA. Following this acquisition, Carasent revised its 2025 targets to approximately NOK 360 million in revenues and NOK 85-90 million EBITDA.

Executive Comment:
CEO Daniel Öhman stated the company identified 'a perfect match, combining a highly competent team with a very strong market standing and attractive customer base,' enabling rollout of Webdoc X in Germany.
